main_text.p: Postquam explicatas longitudines stellarum, recensea-mus magnitudinem corporum earum. Ptole-mæus quidem demonstrauit magnitudinem duo-rum corporum, scilicet solis & lunæ: reliqua-rum vero stellarum mensuram haud explicauit: e-ius tamen rei scientia facile ex iis comparatur, quæ de sole & luna sunt demonstrata. De luna ostendi-tur, quod diameter corporis eius, cum est in longin-quitate orbium suorum, sit æqualis diametro appa-renti corporis solaris, hæc autem deprehenditur esse 31 minutorum, & ⅖ unius minuti: diameter lunæ habet partem unam e tribus & ⅖ unius partis ter-ræ. Diameter solis æqualis est diametris terræ quin-que cum dimidia: ergo mensura corporis lunaris est tricesima nona pars terræ, & mensura corporis so-laris est centesima sexagesima sexta parte maior terra: quatenus partes terræ utrinque æquales ac-cipiuntur.
Sed nos annectamus reliquarum stel-larum magnitudines, quæ apparent in mediis earū distantiis: deinde dicamus, quid sentiendum sit de veris earundem stellarum quantitatibus.

Diameter corporis mercurij apparet esse decima quinta pars diametri solaris, vt sufficienter probatum est: diameter Veneris est pars decima diametri solaris: diameter martis est pars vigesima diametri solaris: diameter Iouis est pars duodecima, & diameter Saturni est pars decima octaua solis: & vnaquæque quindecim stellarum maiorum fixarum est vigesi-ma pars.

page.notes: Printed page with a running head "ALFRAGANI" and page number 116. The text is set in italic type throughout; I have transcribed it in roman, with ⅖ and ⅓ fractions as printed. Some words and fractions were read with doubt, notably "scientia" (read as "scientia"), "vnaquæque", and the fraction signs in "& ⅖ unius minuti" and "& ⅖ unius partis"; these should be checked against the scan. The mark "vigesi-ma" in the last paragraph is printed as "vigesi-" with a hyphen at the line end. Note that the printed italic text was not transcribed in <i>; the page is wholly italic and the rule for whole-page italic applies only where marked. Some readings in the last lines (e.g. "fixarum", "vigesi-mapars") are uncertain.
